description: This is a Perl test script for user lifecycle functionalities in a web application, including registration, email verification, password reset, login/logout, project creation, and role management.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods for simulating user interactions and assertions in web application tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object with optional test data.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the database schema object used for database interactions.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a specified path and checks for a successful response.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Attempts registration with given data and expects failure matching a regex.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Performs registration with valid data and expects success.

methods.name: email_count_is
methods.description: Asserts the number of emails sent matches the expected count.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Checks that the latest email matches a given regex.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Removes the latest email from the email queue.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds an email containing a link matching a regex and performs a GET request on it.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields and expects success.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes the display name of the user and expects success.

methods.name: create_project_ok
methods.description: Creates a new project with specified data and expects success.
